basic_details.job_title: WCDSS Jharkhand Outreach Worker Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Department of Women, Child Development and Social Security (WCDSS Jharkhand) has notified 1 vacancy for the Outreach Worker post on a contract basis under recruitment 2026. Applicants must send the offline application in the prescribed format through Registered Post or Speed Post to the District Child Protection Office, Information and Public Relations Office, Simdega, First Floor (1st Floor) on or before 31 October 2026. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their application in the prescribed format through registered post or speed post to the following address: District Child Protection Office, Information and Public Relations Office, Simdega, First Floor (1st Floor), Pin Code – 835223 Applications received after 31 October 2026 (05:00 PM) will not be accepted. Incomplete applications and those not meeting the required criteria will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Pass in 12th standard or equivalent from a recognized board or university, along with good communication skills. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made on a contract basis for an initial period of one year. The selection committee will review performance before renewing the contract for another year. The selection process involves scrutiny of submitted educational and experience certificates, and shortlisted candidates will undergo police verification.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Outreach Worker post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The appointment is made on a contract basis for an initial period of one year, with provisions for renewal based on satisfactory performance review by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application fee for WCDSS Jharkhand Outreach Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q3. What is the category breakdown for the single available vacancy?
faq.answer: The single vacancy for the Outreach Worker post is reserved under the ST category (ST-01: Total-01).

faq.question: Q4. What specific qualifications or preferences are noted for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed 12th standard or equivalent with good communication skills, and preference will be given to candidates possessing prior work experience.
